Based on the context provided, "lambi" is the local term used in Haiti for a **conch** (specifically referred to as a "large sea snail" or "large marine gastropod"). The text notes that while you can hear the ocean by holding these shells to your ear, eating the snail does not allow you to hear the ocean; the ability to hear the ocean is a property of the shell itself when held to the ear, not a result of consumption.

<answer>Conch</answer>
